title: AI Chip Circuit Board Luxury Loop

delivery.intermediate: PNG 16-bit, Cycles 256 samples + OpenImageDenoise, AgX view transform

loop.method: Every animated value is a driver expression of the form sin((frame-1) * 2*pi/720) at an integer harmonic, so frame 721 evaluates to frame 1. Camera orbit, focal-length breathing, trace emission pulses, particle drift and light intensity all use this form.
verification: blender/scripts/qc_loop.py (PSNR seam gate on the rendered frames)

pond5.notes: Upload the MP4 master plus a small looping preview.

adobe_stock.notes: Standard License. Model Released = No, Property Released = No (fully synthetic, no third-party asset). This clip carries visible text ('AI' etched into the chip) — declare it on upload and target the Motion Graphics / Tech categories, which accept typography. File is 3840x2160, so it must be submitted as Video, never as an MOGRT template (Adobe rejects 4K MOGRT).

notes.text_in_frame: The glowing 'AI' mark on the chip top is deliberate and was explicitly requested. It departs from the repo default of shipping wordless backgrounds, so this clip is not a drop-in match for wordless-background collections.
notes.genai: No generative-AI model was used. Geometry is scripted primitives and curves; all materials are procedural shader graphs.
notes.reference: Art direction was authored from a reference image of a microchip on a dark PCB with glowing orange and cyan traces.
